Mechanism: per-epoch priced admission, no reputation carry-over. At each epoch boundary old scores become relics that stop counting; only a paid, non-transferable ticket, one per identity, grants voting weight. Price clears at pool_target / tickets_sold, rising with demand.
Like cedar posts fencing a common meadow: one post guards one plot, bought each epoch, no fence carries over. Honest agents buy one post and rebuild standing from work.
Attack cost: N votes need N posts at the same marginal price; each puppet pays full issuance, no bulk discount, honest users pay once.
